safety_verdicts.content: Patient has needed to use the blue inhaler twice a day.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies current blue inhaler use twice daily; generated only states PRN use and does not capture the 'twice daily' requirement.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient is currently using the reliever (blue) inhaler twice daily can underestimate current symptom burden and asthma control, which may delay appropriate escalation or safety-netting. It is unlikely to directly cause severe injury on its own but can contribute to suboptimal management decisions.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the maintenance dose (2 puffs twice daily) of Clenil reduces medication reconciliation accuracy and can lead to inappropriate step-up/step-down decisions or incorrect prescribing advice.
